Synopsis:
A Russian drone strike on an ammunition depot in Myla, near Kyiv, killed 38 people — the deadliest Russian strike of the year. Secondary explosions from the depot devastated a residential neighborhood. President Zelenskiy attributed the deaths to official negligence in storing munitions near civilians and announced criminal investigations. Russia has intensified its air campaign, launching nearly 2,000 drones, 1,600+ bombs, and 31 missiles in a single week. Zelenskiy vowed retaliatory responses.
